notes: The summary box ('Amount due: $142.37' / 'Payment due date: November 3, 2026') restates the payment deadline. A model may cite it as a second evidence quote for the same item; a separate item for it counts against precision. The meter replacement window (Oct 26-30) is the utility's own work and a key fact, not a loop for the user. The AutoPay paragraph is a decoy: the user is not enrolled, so there is no 'nothing to do' item. Pages: if page offsets are added to the fixture format later, the payment item is on page 1 and the meter-pit item on page 2.

items.title: Pay the water and power bill
items.quote: Please pay $142.37 by November 3, 2026 to avoid a $15.00 late fee.
items.note: 0.80 + 0.05 exact + 0.05 date agrees = 0.90. Amount copied as written; the $15.00 late fee is the consequence, not the amount due. Could be typed request; evals/run.ts scores type only as informational.
